title: Signup numbers after standup
transcript:
[00:00] Hamid: Quick one before standup. The board deck is due tomorrow and I'm missing the signup numbers.
[00:07] Colm: The dashboard broke when we renamed the events. I'll pull them by hand.
[00:13] Hamid: Can you send me the numbers after standup?
[00:17] Colm: Yes, I'll send them after standup.
[00:21] Beatriz: Include the trial-to-paid figure too. Last deck had it.
[00:25] Colm: Will do.
[00:29] Beatriz: And I'll fix the dashboard this afternoon, it's just the event names.
[00:35] Hamid: Perfect. See you in standup.
